translation.proposed_text_en: (4) An annual adjustment pursuant to subsection 2 or 3 shall not take place if the income from employment is assessed for income tax pursuant to Section 41.
issues: The substantive content of subsections 2 and 3 and Section 41 is not supplied.

clause_span.text: (4) An annual adjustment pursuant to subsection 2 or 3 shall not take place if the income from employment is assessed for income tax pursuant to Section 41

conditions.text: if the income from employment is assessed for income tax pursuant to Section 41
conditions.normalized: employment income is assessed for income tax under Section 41

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The referenced annual-adjustment provisions and Section 41 assessment rule are unavailable, so their internal scope cannot be verified.
The prohibition does not expressly identify the authority that would otherwise carry out the annual adjustment.

records.rationale_summary: The single rule prohibits an annual adjustment under subsection 2 or 3 when employment income is assessed for income tax under Section 41. No administrative actor is inferred from the impersonal wording.

translation.proposed_text_en: If the child supplements have not had an effect, or not in full, with regard to the sole earner tax credit, the full child supplement or the differential amount shall be refunded, taking into account Section 72(5).
issues: The substantive content of Section 72(5) is not supplied.

clause_span.text: If the child supplements have not had an effect, or not in full, with regard to the sole earner tax credit, the full child supplement or the differential amount shall be refunded, taking into account Section 72(5)

actions.normalized: refund full child supplement or differential amount

conditions.text: If the child supplements have not had an effect, or not in full, with regard to the sole earner tax credit
conditions.normalized: child supplements had no or incomplete effect on sole-earner tax credit

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: Section 72(5) is unavailable, so its effect on the refund amount or procedure cannot be expanded.
The refund duty is passive and the responsible authority is not expressly identified.

records.rationale_summary: The rule requires refund of the full child supplement or the differential amount when the supplements had no or incomplete effect on the sole-earner tax credit, subject to Section 72(5). The refunding authority is not inferred.

translation.proposed_text_en: During the calendar year, wage tax cards may only be exchanged upon corresponding application at the tax office of domicile if the wages taxed under the first wage tax card are no longer received.

clause_span.text: During the calendar year, wage tax cards may only be exchanged upon corresponding application at the tax office of domicile if the wages taxed under the first wage tax card are no longer received

conditions.text: if the wages taxed under the first wage tax card are no longer received
conditions.normalized: wages taxed under first wage tax card are no longer received

constraints.text: upon corresponding application at the tax office of domicile
constraints.normalized: upon application to domicile tax office

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The exchange permission is passive and does not expressly identify the applicant or official performing the exchange.

records.rationale_summary: One permission allows wage tax cards to be exchanged during the calendar year only upon application to the domicile tax office and after wages taxed under the first card cease. The cards themselves are regulated objects, not actors.

translation.proposed_text_en: The tax office may, however, upon application, permit that the tax-exempt income components pursuant to Section 3 and the income referred to in Section 26 are not recorded in the wage account if the possibility of verification (Sections 86 et seq.) is ensured in another manner or if it concerns cases of minor significance.
issues: The substantive content of Sections 3, 26, and 86 et seq. is not supplied.

clause_span.text: The tax office may, however, upon application, permit that the tax-exempt income components pursuant to Section 3 and the income referred to in Section 26 are not recorded in the wage account if the possibility of verification (Sections 86 et seq.) is ensured in another manner or if it concerns cases of minor significance

actions.text: permit that the tax-exempt income components pursuant to Section 3 and the income referred to in Section 26 are not recorded in the wage account
actions.normalized: permit omission of specified tax-exempt income from wage account

conditions.text: if the possibility of verification (Sections 86 et seq.) is ensured in another manner or if it concerns cases of minor significance
conditions.normalized: verification is otherwise assured or case is of minor significance

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: The referenced income categories and verification provisions are unavailable, so their internal scope cannot be verified from the excerpt.

records.rationale_summary: The tax office has one conditional permission, exercisable upon application, to allow specified income components to be omitted from the wage account when verification is otherwise ensured or the case is minor. The embedded non-recording phrase is the permitted content, not a separate prohibition.

translation.proposed_text_en: (4) If the wages consist wholly or partly of non-cash benefits and the cash wage is insufficient to cover the wage tax to be withheld, taking into account the value of the non-cash benefits (Section 15(2)), the employee shall pay to the employer the amount required to cover the wage tax to the extent that it is not covered by the cash wage.
issues: The substantive valuation rule in Section 15(2) is not supplied.

clause_span.text: (4) If the wages consist wholly or partly of non-cash benefits and the cash wage is insufficient to cover the wage tax to be withheld, taking into account the value of the non-cash benefits (Section 15(2)), the employee shall pay to the employer the amount required to cover the wage tax to the extent that it is not covered by the cash wage

actions.text: pay to the employer the amount required to cover the wage tax
actions.normalized: pay employer amount needed to cover wage tax

conditions.text: If the wages consist wholly or partly of non-cash benefits and the cash wage is insufficient to cover the wage tax to be withheld, taking into account the value of the non-cash benefits (Section 15(2))
conditions.normalized: wages include non-cash benefits and cash wage is insufficient for withholding tax

constraints.text: to the extent that it is not covered by the cash wage
constraints.normalized: only the amount not covered by cash wage

unsupported_or_ambiguous.reason: Section 15(2), which supplies the non-cash-benefit valuation rule used in the condition, is unavailable.

records.rationale_summary: The employee must pay the employer the wage-tax shortfall when wages include non-cash benefits and the cash wage cannot cover the withholding calculated with their value. The amount is limited to the portion not covered by cash wage.
